title: measure_packet_motion.py --xmax flag parsed without bounds or type guard — unhandled traceback instead of usage exit
detail: Flag value is indexed and int()-cast unguarded: `--xmax` as the final argv token raises IndexError; a non-numeric value raises ValueError. Raw traceback, exit 1 — bypassing the guarded exit-2 convention this fix round added for every other input (W3/W4/W12).
recommended_fix: Guard the flag parse: if '--xmax' is the last token or int() raises, print usage and return 2 — matching the isdir/frame-name validated exits already in main().
